scope: 26 targeted questions rewritten to differentiate learning objectives. IDs, subject, module, topic, difficulty label and correct option index retained; stems, alternatives, explanations and source references updated. Lexical screening is not exhaustive semantic or legal certification.
method: Same TF-IDF screening criteria as semantic-similarity-audit-2026-11-26.json; recomputed weights on the revised corpus; compared each changed question with all other questions and rechecked all 27 original flagged pairs. No embedding model or student-performance calibration.
limitations: No comprehensive legal certification of the full 2,000-question bank.
Difficulty labels preserved, not empirically calibrated.
Previously retained complementary pairs were not rewritten.
